A plugin on beta is offered both beta and stable versions. A plugin on stable is offered only stable versions. reference-dependency-resolution Review against the page text
PKG-355 The following MUST hold. A switch from beta to stable never installs a lower version by itself. The plugin stays at its version until a stable version with a higher precedence appears. ilium plugin install <id>@<version> --allow-downgrade is the explicit way back. reference-dependency-resolution Review against the page text
PKG-356 The following MUST hold. A file install ignores channels. The version is whatever the file holds. The record keeps channel: dev for ilium plugin dev and channel: file for other files. reference-dependency-resolution Review against the page text
PKG-357 The following MUST hold. Administrators can limit the allowed channels with the policy key packages.allowed_channels. See Administrator guide. reference-dependency-resolution Review against the page text
PKG-358 The following MUST hold. ilium plugin pin <id>@<version> records an exact version. Update commands skip pinned plugins, and the resolver treats a pin as the only allowed version of that id. ilium plugin unpin <id> removes it. reference-dependency-resolution Review against the page text
PKG-359 The following MUST hold. The lock file ilium-plugins.lock is JSON: { "format": "ilium-lock/1", "plugins": [ { "id", "version", "sha256", "source" } ] }, sorted by id. ilium plugin lock writes it from the installed set. ilium plugin install --locked <file> installs exactly those versions. A locked version that no source offers fails with dependency.unresolved. A resolution that differs from the lock fails with dependency.lock-mismatch. reference-dependency-resolution Assert code dependency.unresolved
PKG-360 The following MUST hold. A lock file entry whose sha256 differs from the SHA-256 of the downloaded package is refused with registry.hash-mismatch. reference-dependency-resolution Assert code registry.hash-mismatch
PKG-361 A registry MUST be usable as a static file tree over HTTPS for reading. Reading MUST NOT need a server-side program. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-362 A client MUST verify every metadata document against the registry root keys before it uses any value from it. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-363 A client MUST verify the SHA-256 and the length of a downloaded package against the index before it parses the package, and then run all install stages of Package format reference. The registry never replaces those checks. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-364 root.json MUST be signed by at least threshold of its own roles.root keys. A new root MUST also be signed by the threshold of the previous root's keys, and its version MUST be the previous version plus 1. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-365 The client MUST stop and report registry.metadata-expired when a document's expires time is in the past, unless the client works in offline mode with a cached index (see below). reference-registry Assert code registry.metadata-expired
PKG-366 Version numbers are integers that never go down. A client MUST remember the highest version it has seen for each document and MUST refuse a lower one with registry.rollback. reference-registry Assert code registry.rollback
PKG-367 timestamp.json MUST expire within 1 day of its issue. snapshot.json SHOULD expire within 7 days, root.json within 1 year. A registry operator renews the first two by re-signing without content change. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-368 index.json and each plugins/<id>.json MUST match the hash, length and version in snapshot.json. A mismatch is registry.hash-mismatch. reference-registry Assert code registry.hash-mismatch
PKG-369 The following MUST hold. The maximum sizes are: root.json 64 KiB, timestamp.json 16 KiB, snapshot.json 4 MiB, index.json 32 MiB, each plugins/<id>.json 1 MiB, revocations.json 4 MiB. A larger response is aborted with registry.size. reference-registry Assert code registry.size
PKG-370 The following MUST hold. The sequence in which a client refreshes is: fetch timestamp.json; if its snapshot version is unchanged, stop; fetch snapshot.json; fetch each changed file listed in it. A client fetches root.json first only when the timestamp signature fails with the known keys. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-652 The following MUST hold. The signature of a metadata document covers the JCS (RFC 8785) form of its signed value. A client MUST parse with refusal of duplicate keys, serialise signed again with JCS and verify over those bytes. The result for the vector of the metadata section MUST have the SHA-256 given there. reference-registry Verify a document with reordered keys and extra whitespace and check the vector SHA-256
PKG-653 The following MUST hold. revocations.json MUST carry the signed and signatures wrapper and MUST be signed with the timestamp role keys. Without a valid signature of the threshold it is refused with registry.signature-invalid. reference-registry Serve an unsigned and a signed revocations.json
PKG-655 The following MUST hold. A namespace is dormant when no version was published for 730 days and no install or update was reported in 365 days. The registry MUST compute dormancy from publish dates in the metadata. A maintained: true statement defers dormancy until it is 730 days old.
PKG-656 The registry MUST NOT reassign a dormant namespace unless it is dormant as defined in PKG-655, a notice was sent and published, 90 days passed without reply, and no version is installed. The refusal code is registry.namespace-not-dormant. A reclaim MUST be recorded as reclaimed_from.
PKG-657 The client MUST show the notice dormant namespace with the last publish date in the detail page and in ilium plugin list. The notice MUST NOT block use, update or removal. The client MUST warn before an update that follows a reclaim.
PKG-371 A client MUST use HTTPS. A plain http: base URL is refused with registry.insecure-url, except for localhost in a development configuration ([plugins.registry] allow_insecure_localhost = true). reference-registry Assert code registry.insecure-url
PKG-372 The client MUST send If-None-Match with the stored ETag of a document and accept 304 Not Modified. It MUST follow at most 3 redirects and only to HTTPS. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-373 The following MUST hold. Timeouts: 10 s to connect, 30 s to the first byte of a metadata document, 120 s total for a metadata document, 600 s total for a package download. Retries: up to 3 attempts for connection errors and for 5xx responses, with waits of 1 s, 2 s and 4 s. A 4xx response is not retried. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-374 The following MUST hold. The client reads HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY and the [plugins.registry] proxy setting. The setting wins. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-375 A download is written to a temporary file under the cache folder and renamed only after the hash and length match. A resumed download MUST use Range and MUST verify the final hash. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-376 The following MUST hold. The only request data the client sends is the HTTP request itself: the path, the standard headers and User-Agent: ilium/<version>. It sends no identifier, no list of installed plugins and no install count. A registry operator who wants statistics reads their own server logs. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-377 The following MUST hold. The configured registries are listed in [plugins.registry] urls in order (default: none). A registry marked default is searched first. A client with no URLs makes no network request. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-378 Offline behaviour: the client keeps the last verified set of metadata in the cache folder. When the network fails, it uses the cached metadata and shows its age. [PKG-378] A cached index MAY be used after its expires time only when the user passes --offline or sets `[plugins.registry] offline = reference-registry Assert code registry.metadata-expired
PKG-379 The following MUST hold. A search query is a string of at most 200 characters. The client splits it on whitespace into terms, folds case and accents (Unicode NFKD, remove combining marks) and requires every term to match as a prefix of a word in id, name, description, keywords or publisher. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-380 The following MUST hold. The relevance score of a match is the sum over terms of: 8 for a match in id, 6 in name, 4 in keywords, 2 in publisher, 1 in description. Ties break by updated (newer first), then by id. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-381 The following MUST hold. Ranking uses no download counts and no user ratings in version 0.1. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-382 The following MUST hold. Sort orders: relevance (default with a query), name (A to Z, default without a query), updated (newest first). reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-383 The following MUST hold. Pagination: the client shows pages of 20 results. ilium plugin search --limit <1..100> --offset <n> applies the same rule. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-384 The following MUST hold. The category filter takes one value from the list below. A plugin lists 1 to 3 categories. A value outside the list is refused at publish with registry.category-unknown. reference-registry Assert code registry.category-unknown
PKG-385 The following MUST hold. A registry publisher id is one of: a reverse-DNS name of a domain that the publisher controls (com.example), or a registry account name written user.<name>, where <name> is 3 to 32 characters and matches the segment grammar of PKG-217 ([a-z][a-z0-9]*(-[a-z0-9]+)*). reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-386 The following MUST hold. A domain publisher id is claimed by proving control of the domain: the publisher adds a DNS TXT record _ilium-publisher.<domain> with the value ilium-publisher=<publisher_id>;key=<key_id>. The registry checks the record at claim time and again every 30 days. A domain whose record disappears lose reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-387 The following MUST hold. The reserved prefixes are ilium., core., local., test. and example.. A publish with such an id is refused with registry.id-reserved. The prefix user. is reserved for account ids and cannot be claimed as a domain. reference-registry Assert code registry.id-reserved
PKG-388 A plugin id MUST start with the publisher id of its signature plus a dot (rule [PKG-218]). A publish whose id belongs to another namespace is refused with registry.namespace-unowned. reference-registry Assert code registry.namespace-unowned
PKG-389 The following MUST hold. Confusable check. At claim and publish the registry computes a skeleton of the id in this order: 1, NFKC normalisation, then lowercase; 2, each non-ASCII character is mapped with confusables.txt of Unicode 16.0.0; 3, the characters -, _ and . are removed; 4, in one pass from left to right, rn becomes m, vv becomes w, 0 becomes o, 1 and l become i, and 5 becomes s. A new id or publisher id whose skeleton equals the skeleton of an existing different one is refused with registry.confusable, and a human reviews the exception. Vectors: r-n.tool and m.tool give mtooi; vv.tool and w.tool give wtooi; Ilium.Tool and ilium_tool give iiiumtooi; examp1e.n0tes and example.notes give exampienotes; corn gives com. reference-registry Assert code registry.confusable
PKG-390 The following MUST hold. Transfer. The owner of a namespace can transfer it to a new publisher id by publishing a transfer statement signed by a trusted key of the current owner, naming the new publisher id and key. The registry records the transfer in the plugin metadata (transferred_from). Installed clients accept the n reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-391 The following MUST hold. Disputes. A claim dispute is decided by the registry operator under the published policy. An id is never reassigned to a different publisher when its versions are still installed by users, except by a takedown and a clearly marked new publisher. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-392 ilium plugin publish <file> --registry <url> [--channel stable\|beta] MUST send the package with PUT <base>/publish/<id>/<version> over HTTPS. The body is the package. The Authorization header holds a registry token from ILIUM_REGISTRY_TOKEN or the credential file of the registry. Tokens are never written to a log. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-393 The following MUST hold. The server runs install stages 1 to 7 on the upload, including the signature check (stage 4) and key trust (stage 7), and a policy check. It refuses the publish with the same codes as the client would, plus the registry codes. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-394 The following MUST hold. A version number is immutable. A publish of an existing id@version is refused with registry.version-exists, even when the content is identical. A fixed package needs a new version. reference-registry Assert code registry.version-exists
PKG-395 The following MUST hold. On success the server adds the version to plugins/<id>.json, stores blobs/<sha256>.iliumpkg, adds a registry countersignature to a copy of the signature document (a second entry of signatures, see [PKG-207]), recomputes snapshot.json and timestamp.json, and answers 201 with a JSON body ` reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-396 The following MUST hold. Yank. ilium plugin yank <id>@<version> --reason <text> marks a version as yanked. Clients do not choose it for a new install or update. Installed copies keep working. unyank reverses it. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-397 The following MUST hold. Deprecate. ilium plugin deprecate <id> --message <text> [--successor <id>] marks the whole plugin. Clients show the message and offer the successor. Installs still work. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-398 The following MUST hold. Unlist. A publisher can unlist a plugin: it disappears from index.json and from search, but plugins/<id>.json and the blobs remain so that installed copies update safely and lock files still resolve. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-399 A publisher MUST NOT delete a published blob. Removal happens only through takedown (below). reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-400 The following MUST hold. Upload limits: 300 MiB per package (the package format cap), 20 publishes per hour per publisher id. A larger upload is refused with registry.size. reference-registry Assert code registry.size
PKG-401 Review levels. Level A: automated checks only (all package checks, a scan for known-bad hashes, the confusable check). Level B: a human review is also required when the package requests any high-risk grant (process.run, fs.write outside the plugin scope, http with *, agent.control, commands.invoke:*) or replaces, or when it is the first publish of a publisher id. A registry MUST state which level applies to which version on the plugin page. reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-402 The following MUST hold. Content policy. A registry refuses plugins that: contain malware or hidden data collection, impersonate another publisher or product, hide behaviour that the manifest does not declare, or break the law of the registry's jurisdiction. The operator publishes this policy at policy.json or on its site reference-registry Assert code policy.json
PKG-403 The following MUST hold. Takedown. An operator removes a version or a plugin by adding it to revocations.json (blocked_ids) and removing the blob. The reason and time are recorded. At the next metadata refresh the client moves the installed copies that match to the package state disabled-blocked (plugin lifecycle states), with the reason registry.takedown and the registry's reason text, and shows both. ilium plugin enable <id> --accept-risk enables the plugin again. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-404 The following MUST hold. Appeal. A publisher can appeal a takedown once, in writing to the contact in policy.json. The operator answers within 14 days. A reinstated plugin gets a new version number. reference-registry Assert code policy.json
PKG-405 The following MUST hold. Emergency revocation of a publisher key follows [PKG-242] to [PKG-247]. The registry adds the key to revocations.json. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-406 Ratings and reviews. User ratings and reviews are out of scope for 0.1. A registry compliant with this page MUST NOT show a rating, and a client MUST NOT send one. A later version of this page may add them. The policy for any future rating: only users of a version may rate it, a rating needs moderat reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-407 Revocations travel in revocations.json. [PKG-407] A client MUST fetch it on every metadata refresh, and MUST apply keys to its trust store (status revoked, added_by: registry is not used for revocations) and blocked_ids to its installed plugins. The effects are those of [PKG-244] to [PKG-2 reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-408 The following MUST hold. A full mirror serves a byte-identical copy of the file tree. Because every document is signed and the blobs are named by hash, the signature chain survives mirroring unchanged. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-409 A partial mirror serves a subset: a list of plugin ids with their dependencies. It MUST include the metadata files, index.json filtered to the subset and a snapshot.json that lists only the mirrored files. A partial mirror re-signs index.json and snapshot.json with its own keys and has its o reference-registry Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-410 ilium plugin mirror sync <dir> --registry <url> [--allow <id>...] [--channel stable\|beta] MUST copy the metadata and the blobs to <dir> and verify every hash. For a full copy, omit --allow. The command is idempotent: it downloads only changed files. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-411 The following MUST hold. A client configured with a mirror URL uses it exactly like a registry. The root keys are the ones in the client's configuration ([plugins.registry] root), never fetched from the mirror alone, except at the first setup where ilium plugin registry add <url> --root-key <key_id> pins them. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-412 The following MUST hold. ilium plugin export-bundle <dir> <id>[@range]... [--with-deps] writes a bundle with the signed metadata of the registry, filtered to the listed plugins, and their blobs. The bundle keeps the original signatures. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-413 The following MUST hold. ilium plugin install --from-bundle <dir> <id> installs from the bundle. The client verifies the metadata with the root keys pinned in its configuration, enforces expiry (unless --offline) and rollback rules against its stored versions, and runs the normal install stages. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-414 The following MUST hold. A bundle's snapshot.json expires like any other. For a long-lived air-gapped setup the operator re-exports a bundle regularly or sets offline = true. reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-415 When network unreachable, the client MUST do this: Use the cache if valid. Otherwise report registry.unreachable, exit 8. A file install is unaffected reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-416 When metadata expired, the client MUST do this: Refuse to install from it. Offer --offline reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-417 When rollback, the client MUST do this: Refuse, keep the old cache, report the two versions reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-418 When hash mismatch on a package, the client MUST do this: Delete the partial download, refuse, never retry the same URL more than the transport retries reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-419 When signature threshold not met, the client MUST do this: Refuse. Do not use the document at all reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-420 When a version the user asked for is yanked, the client MUST do this: Refuse unless --allow-yanked. Dependency resolution skips yanked versions silently reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-421 When revoked key in a freshly fetched package, the client MUST do this: Refuse with trust.key-revoked reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-422 When a different registry returns the same id, the client MUST do this: The first registry in the configured order wins. --registry <url> selects one. A plugin installed from one registry updates only from it reference-registry Review against the page text
PKG-423 Every command on this page MUST exit with a code of this table, and the exit_code of its result record MUST equal the process exit code. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-424 A policy refusal (policy.*, package.blocked) MUST exit 7. registry.unreachable, registry.stale, registry.metadata-expired and install.download-failed MUST exit 8. A declined prompt (install.review-declined, trust.declined) and install.needs-input are failures and MUST exit 1. Any o reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code package.blocked, registry.unreachable, registry.stale, registry.metadata-expired, install.download-failed, install.revie
PKG-425 A command MUST NOT start work and then exit 2. Usage errors are found before any file or network access. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-426 install MUST classify the source in this order: a URL (it has ://): https is a download; an argument that is a file path (it contains / or \, starts with . or ~, or ends in .iliumpkg), which fails with usage.file-not-found when nothing is at that path or the path is a directory; otherwise a registry id. A URL with the scheme http fails with install.insecure-url; a URL with any other scheme fails with install.source-scheme. An id with --from-bundle reads the bundle and never the network. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code install.source-scheme
PKG-427 --dry-run MUST run stages 1 to 10 of Package format, print the review as records, change no file under the plugin root, and exit with the code the real install would give. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-428 --locked MUST install exactly the versions and package hashes of ilium-plugins.lock and fail with dependency.lock-mismatch on any difference. It never contacts a registry for resolution. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code dependency.lock-mismatch
PKG-429 --yes skips the review dialog as in Plugin command line. --yes does not confirm a new high-risk grant or a new replaces entry; only --grant <grant> for that exact grant does. --yes MUST NOT trust a new key. Only --trust <key_id> does. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-430 With no attached client and no --yes, install MUST fail with install.review-required and exit 1 (the missing decision is the grant review; install.needs-input stays for any other decision nobody can answer). It MUST NOT wait for input that cannot come. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code install.review-required
PKG-431 update of an id that is not installed MUST fail with install.not-installed and exit 5. When the newest allowed version equals the installed one, it MUST print a plugin record and exit 0. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code install.not-installed
PKG-432 update --all MUST continue after a failure of one plugin, print every failure, and exit 1 when at least one plugin failed. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-433 rollback with no previous version on disk MUST fail with install.no-previous and exit 5. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code install.no-previous
PKG-434 pin and channel MUST change only installed.json and MUST be idempotent. channel dev is refused with usage.invalid-value: the dev channel exists only for ilium plugin dev. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-435 search with no registry configured MUST fail with registry.none-configured and exit 1. It MUST NOT use the network when the only configured source is a bundle: it searches the bundle index. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code registry.none-configured
PKG-436 verify MUST NOT change any file and MUST NOT run plugin code. It exits 0 when stages 1 to 7 pass, as in [PKG-156]. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-437 info of an unknown id MUST fail with plugin.not-found and exit 5. Registry fields (yanked, deprecated, successor) MUST appear in the plugin record when the source is a registry. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-438 registry add MUST fail with registry.root-key-missing when --root-key is absent, with registry.insecure-url for a plain http: URL (PKG-371 allows localhost only when allow_insecure_localhost = true), and with usage.invalid-value for any other scheme that is not https (a file:// folder is allowed for bundles and mirrors). reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code registry.root-key-missing
PKG-439 mirror sync MUST verify every document and blob before it writes them, MUST write the folder atomically per file, and MUST NOT change any signed byte. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-440 export-bundle MUST fail with dependency.unsatisfied listing the missing id when --with-deps is absent and a dependency is not in the set. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code dependency.unsatisfied
PKG-441 publish MUST run verify first and refuse an unsigned package (publish.unsigned) or a package whose version already exists in the registry (registry.version-exists). It MUST NOT print the upload credential. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code publish.unsigned, registry.version-exists
PKG-442 publish reads its credential from the environment variable ILIUM_REGISTRY_TOKEN or from --token-file. It MUST NOT accept the token as a flag value. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-443 yank and deprecate MUST NOT delete a blob. They change the signed metadata only (see Registry reference). reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-444 keygen, sign and trust MUST use the file formats, the fingerprint and the codes of Signing and trust. A page that shows another format is wrong. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-445 The following MUST hold. trust failures exit 1, except trust.not-found (5). A declined prompt (trust.declined) exits 1, as [PKG-424] says. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Assert code trust.not-found
PKG-446 A secret variable MUST NOT appear in any record, log or error message. reference-plugin-distribution-cli Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-460 To allow only plugins from your company, an administrator MUST set publishers.allow with the company key fingerprint and packages.allowed_sources with the company registry. guide-plugin-administration Set both keys, install a plugin from another publisher, and assert policy.blocked with detail policy.publisher-denied
PKG-461 To allow only bundled plugins, an administrator MUST set packages.allow_third_party = false. guide-plugin-administration Set the key, install a third-party package, and assert policy.blocked with detail policy.third-party-denied
PKG-462 To block one plugin, an administrator MUST set plugins.deny_ids = ["com.example.bad"]. guide-plugin-administration Set the key, install that id, and assert policy.blocked with detail policy.id-denied
PKG-463 To block a risky grant everywhere, an administrator MUST set grants.deny = ["process.run:*"]. guide-plugin-administration Set the key, install a plugin that requests it, and assert the grant row is locked with policy.grant-forbidden
PKG-464 To stop beta builds, an administrator MUST set packages.allowed_channels = ["stable"]. guide-plugin-administration Set the key, install a beta build, and assert that the install is refused with policy.blocked
PKG-465 An administrator MAY add a key with ilium plugin trust add <file> --tier T2 --system. A key added this way has added_by: admin and the user cannot remove it. guide-plugin-administration Review against the page text
PKG-466 A key in the trust store never overrides a revocation. A revoked key stays revoked. guide-plugin-administration Add a key to the trust store, revoke it, and assert trust.key-revoked on the next install
PKG-467 A registry MUST be served over HTTPS. The client refuses plain http: except localhost in development (PKG-371). guide-plugin-administration Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-468 The timestamp document expires after one day. The operator MUST re-sign it at least daily, or clients report registry.stale. guide-plugin-administration Assert code registry.stale
PKG-469 To rotate the root key, the operator MUST publish a rotation document signed by the old and the new key. See Registry reference. guide-plugin-administration Review against the page text
PKG-470 packages.allowed_sources is defined in Plugin policy. A source that is not in the list is refused with policy.blocked (detail policy.source-denied). guide-plugin-administration Assert code policy.blocked with detail policy.source-denied
PKG-471 packages.allow_url_installs is defined in Plugin policy. When it is false, a URL install is refused with policy.blocked (detail policy.source-denied). guide-plugin-administration Assert code policy.blocked with detail policy.source-denied
PKG-472 packages.allowed_channels is defined in Plugin policy. A package on a channel outside the list is refused with policy.blocked. guide-plugin-administration Assert code policy.blocked
PKG-473 A full mirror MUST NOT be signed by the mirror operator. Clients check the signatures of the original registry. The one exception is a partial mirror ([PKG-409]), which signs with its own keys and its own root.json; clients verify that mirror against its own root, set in [plugins.registry]. guide-plugin-administration Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-474 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. With packages.allowed_sources set to the mirror, a client that cannot reach the mirror reports registry.unreachable and never falls back to another registry. guide-plugin-administration Assert code registry.unreachable
PKG-475 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. packages.allowed_sources compares the scheme, host and path prefix of the configured URL. A trailing slash does not matter. guide-plugin-administration Review against the page text
PKG-476 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. A package installed before the policy changed is not removed. It follows the existing disabled-by-policy rule of the policy page. guide-plugin-administration Review against the page text
PKG-477 An automatic update MUST run all install checks, and MUST NOT install when new grants or a new signing key would need a prompt. It then notifies only. guide-plugin-administration Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-490 The plugin id MUST start with <publisher_id>. of the signing key (PKG-218). Otherwise signing fails with manifest.id-publisher. guide-publishing Assert code manifest.id-publisher
PKG-491 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. Use SemVer. Raise the major number when you remove a command, a service function or a setting. See Versions and dependencies. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-492 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. A version is immutable once published. A fix needs a new version (PKG-394). guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-493 The private key MUST NOT be stored in the plugin repository. For CI, put it in a secret store and pass it through ILIUM_PUBLISHER_KEY (PEM text) or ILIUM_PLUGIN_SIGNING_KEY (path of a key file). guide-publishing Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-494 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. Encrypt a key kept on disk. Pass the passphrase through ILIUM_KEY_PASSPHRASE, never on the command line. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-495 Authors SHOULD pin the toolchain version in the repository (rust-toolchain.toml or package-lock.json). guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-496 Authors SHOULD build with the lock file frozen (cargo build --locked, npm ci). guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-497 Authors SHOULD NOT embed the build time, the user name or an absolute path. In Rust set --remap-path-prefix. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-498 Authors SHOULD write build-info.json with the toolchain name and version and the source commit. pack includes it and the registry shows it. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-499 Verify: build twice in clean folders and compare sha256sum of the two .iliumpkg files. They MUST be equal. guide-publishing Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-500 Authors SHOULD put sbom.json in the project root. pack includes it as sbom.json. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-501 The file SHOULD be CycloneDX 1.5 JSON or SPDX 2.3 JSON. The host reads it as opaque data and does not validate its content. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-502 The file MUST be at most 4 MiB. A larger file fails with package.size-limit. guide-publishing Assert code package.size-limit
PKG-503 Authors SHOULD generate it from the lock file, for example cargo cyclonedx or npx @cyclonedx/cyclonedx-npm. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-504 A registry at review level B MAY require an SBOM (PKG-401). guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-505 Authors SHOULD sign only after the final pack. Changing any file after signing makes manifest.file-hash or manifest.signature-invalid. guide-publishing Assert code manifest.file-hash, manifest.signature-invalid
PKG-506 Authors SHOULD run verify and install the file on a clean machine before you upload. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-507 Authors SHOULD follow this advice. A publish limit of 20 per hour per publisher applies (PKG-400). guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-508 Authors SHOULD start new plugins on the beta channel with --channel beta, then publish a later version to stable once beta users report no problems. guide-publishing Review against the page text
PKG-530 The store MUST show one row per plugin id with name, publisher, latest version, tier badge and a short description. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-531 The category filter MUST offer only the closed category list of Registry reference. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-532 With no registry configured the store MUST show the empty state "No registry is set up" with the command to add one. It MUST NOT contact the network. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-533 Yanked versions MUST NOT appear in results. A deprecated plugin MUST show a badge and its successor. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-534 The following MUST hold. User ratings are not shown (not in 0.1). user-plugin-store Review against the page text
PKG-535 The detail view MUST list every requested grant with its risk level, as the review dialog does. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-536 The detail view MUST show the publisher id and key status: trusted, unknown or revoked. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-537 A plugin with a revoked key or a blocked id MUST NOT have an Install button. It shows the reason. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-538 Install from the store MUST use the same pipeline and dialog as a file install. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-539 The store MUST show an update badge when the registry has a newer allowed version. It MUST NOT install it unless the user chooses, or has set auto_update = install. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-540 When offline the store MUST show the cache age and mark the view as stale. user-plugin-store Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-541 The store MUST refuse metadata older than the expiry rule and show registry.metadata-expired. user-plugin-store Assert code registry.metadata-expired
PKG-560 The schema document MUST declare $schema as https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema and $id as urn:ilium:schema:plugin-manifest:0.1.0. It MUST NOT use a keyword outside the 2020-12 core and validation vocabularies. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-561 ilium plugin check and the installer MUST accept exactly the manifests that this schema accepts at stage 3, and MUST apply the extra rules of the list below at stages 3 and 4. PKG-562 The following MUST hold. A schema failure maps to a code in this order: a property outside properties gives manifest.unknown-key; a missing required property gives manifest.key-missing; a failing pattern on id gives manifest.id-invalid; a failing pattern on version gives manifest.version-invalid; a faili reference-manifest-schema Assert code manifest.unknown-key, manifest.key-missing, manifest.id-invalid, manifest.version-invalid, manifest.display-name, manife
PKG-563 The schema MUST NOT be fetched from the network. A copy ships with the host and with ilium plugin check, and ilium plugin check --print-schema writes it to standard output. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-564 The installer MUST refuse with manifest.id-reserved an id that starts with ilium. or that equals a reserved publisher id of PKG-220.. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-565 The installer MUST refuse this input with manifest.exports-mismatch: the exports list of a component matches the exports of the real component.. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-566 When each grant exists in this API version, its argument follows the grammar and it is available on its side., the client MUST do this: manifest.grant-unknown and the grant codes reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-567 The installer MUST refuse this input with manifest.when-syntax, manifest.settings-key-clash: when and visible_when expressions parse, and settings keys are unique.. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-568 When ids are unique inside each contribution list, and commands, topics and services follow the prefix rules of their pages (a services or commands name may also use the id of a core plugin named in this package's replaces list, for items in that core plugin's surface)., the client MUST do this: the code of the contribution reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-569 The installer MUST refuse this input with manifest.requires-invalid, manifest.requires-self: requires ranges parse, and requires.plugins holds no duplicate and not the plugin itself.. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-570 The installer MUST refuse this input with manifest.file-missing: the side of each declared component has its file in the archive, and each file in help/ and sounds/ named by a contribution exists.. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-571 The following MUST hold. Every error is one JSONL line with type error, a code from this page, a message built from the template, a stage (number or letter as above) and, when a place exists, a pointer (RFC 6901) or a path. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-572 A template placeholder in braces MUST be replaced with the value. A template MUST NOT contain a secret, a token or the content of a file outside the package. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-573 The following MUST hold. The message is English text. The code is the stable interface: tools and tests match the code and never the message. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-574 The following MUST hold. When several errors occur, the exit code is that of the first error printed. reference-manifest-schema Review against the page text
PKG-578 The following MUST hold. Within a stage, errors are printed in the order of the central directory entry they concern (errors without an entry first), and for one entry in the order of the check list of the stage. Manifest errors sort by JSON pointer in byte order. A conformance row that names an expected result lists every code it expects, in print order, not only the first. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test: pack a package with two bad entries and assert the printed order
PKG-575 A host MUST NOT print a code that is not in this catalogue. A new code needs an entry here first. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-579 accepts_messages_from MUST be a list of at most 32 distinct plugin ids. A plugin MUST receive peer messages only from listed ids ([SVC-030]). Other keys of the extension and service tables follow reference-manifest: on_failure, final_check and guard are allowed only as described there, else manifest.extension-point-invalid; requires.services entries MUST be <name>@<major>.<minor>.<patch>, else manifest.service-version. reference-manifest Review against the page text
PKG-576 Every code of this catalogue MUST appear in at least one test of the conformance suite with the stage and the exit code shown. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-577 A host MUST NOT print a retired code. A test that expects a retired code is wrong and MUST be updated to the replacement. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-581 The host MUST refuse an install whose package source (registry URL, mirror or local file) is not in the administrator allowed_sources list with policy.blocked (detail policy.source-denied). reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-582 A cli contribution that names a name owned by the kernel itself (plugin, session, kill-session, help, version) MUST be refused with manifest.cli-name-reserved. The names recap, progress, wait, chat, panes, broadcast, new-pane and voice are owned by bundled core plugins: only that core plugin may declare its own, and any other plugin is refused with manifest.cli-name-taken, which is used for a name that another installed plugin owns. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-583 An extension point that declares a risk level lower than the grant its handlers receive, or an unknown risk, MUST be refused with manifest.point-risk. reference-manifest-schema Conformance test of the stated behaviour
PKG-680 A version MUST be at review level B only when a review record names the reviewer, the time and the package SHA-256, the package contains sbom.json of at most 4 MiB, the manifest license is a valid SPDX expression, and the package contains a LICENSE or NOTICE file. A version that lacks any of these MUST be at level A. reference-registry Publish packages that lack each item in turn and read the computed level
PKG-681 A registry that requires level B MUST refuse a publish without the SBOM, a valid SPDX licence or a licence notice with registry.policy and the detail sbom-missing, license-invalid or license-notice-missing, before review. reference-registry Publish to a level B registry without each item and read the code and detail
PKG-682 At level A the SBOM and the licence notice MUST stay optional. A version without them MUST be accepted, MUST show No SBOM or No licence notice, and MUST NOT carry the level B badge. reference-registry Publish at level A without both and read the plugin page and the badge
PKG-683 The level B badge MUST be derived from the review record of that exact version and package hash. A new version, another hash or a withdrawn record MUST return the version to level A. reference-registry Review a version, publish the next one, re-upload another hash, withdraw the record, read the badge each time
PKG-684 Each version entry of index.json MUST carry review_level, sbom and license_notice. A client MUST show the level B badge only when review_level is "B" and both booleans are true, and MUST show level A when a field is missing. reference-registry Serve entries with each field removed and read the badge
PKG-685 The publishing guide SHOULD list sbom.json, an SPDX license and a LICENSE or NOTICE file as the inputs for level B. guide-publishing Read the guide row and compare it with PKG-680

Duplicates and orphans

Duplicates: none.

Orphans: none.
